title: MLS as single source of truth: remove duplicated group state
description: Queued by Mark 2026-10-17 after the FIXCHECK batch. (1) Add ARCHITECTURE principle: MLS group state is the single source of truth for group membership and its order; anything outside MLS derives membership from MLS artifacts (epoch, ratchet tree, signed GroupInfo) instead of keeping its own list. (2) Focused pass listing every place the spec duplicates MLS state, with derive-from-MLS proposals. Main candidate: replace DMMembers at the DM admission host with member-supplied signed GroupInfo + public ratchet tree (host accepts a valid GroupInfo for a later epoch). Also: DMGroupDescriptor members array. Not candidates: sequencer (it is the RFC 9420 DS ordering role), relay admission/keyEpoch, Space roles, logger non-removability. Bring as decisions one at a time.
